The presidency of Martin Van Buren began on March 4 , 1837 , when Martin Van Buren was inaugurated as President of the United States , and ended on March 4 , 1841 . Van Buren , the incumbent Vice President and chosen successor of President Andrew Jackson , took office as the eighth United States president , after winning the 1836 presidential election . [P3] Presidency of Martin Van Buren
Additionally , relations with Britain and its colonies in Canada proved to be strained from the bloodless Aroostook War and the Caroline Affair . During the insurrections in Canada Van Buren successfully proclaimed American neutrality . Van Buren 's four-year presidency was marked as much by failure and criticism as by success and popular acclaim . His presidency is considered average , at best , by historians .
